exposure: excessive rate of third trimester GWG
excessive rate of first and third trimester GWG
cohort: 1,215 Hispanic women participating in Proyecto Buena Salud from 2006 to 2011
finding: Obesity prior to pregnancy and excessive GWG across pregnancy, particularly an excessive rate of third trimester GWG, were associated with increased odds of cesarean delivery among Hispanics.
mod_finding: This study found that pre-pregnancy obesity and excessive gestational weight gain were associated with increased odds of cesarean delivery among Hispanic women.
